scope: Characterize POST /scenarios/save in main_web.py. Pin all current behavior, side effects, quirks, and response shapes. No extraction yet (that is 51J-2).

characterized_behaviors: POST /scenarios/save exists in main_web.py
Unauthenticated -> 302 redirect to /login (NOT 401 JSON; this is HTMX-redirect auth pattern, not JSON pattern)
Authenticated + factory_template / saved_baseline project -> 200 + workspace render with 'Save is not available for {origin} {code}. Use Save As to create a user project.' message (soft-block)
Authenticated + user_created (or other) project -> 200 + workspace render with 'Saved scenario snapshot for {project_name}.' message (success)
user_id always derived from session, never from form
Form is collected ONCE via _collect_form_snapshot(form); no per-field reads (except snapshot.get('scenario', 'Base'))
scenario_name is built as f'{project_name} {snapshot.get(scenario, Base)} {dt.now().strftime(%Y-%m-%d %H:%M)}' (timestamp is the name suffix)
Block check is structural (early return); save_scenario and bind_workspace_to_scenario are NEVER called in the blocked branch
save_scenario is called exactly once per success (after the block check)
bind_workspace_to_scenario is called exactly once per success (after save_scenario)
last_run_summary is preserved if and only if existing_workspace_state exists AND its last_runtime_snapshot equals the current snapshot (otherwise reset to {})
replay_metadata.export_type for save_scenario is 'saved_scenario_snapshot'
replay_metadata.export_type for bind_workspace_to_scenario is 'workspace_saved_boundary' (with non-ASCII char)
save_scenario's replay_metadata does NOT pass scenario_id explicitly (the repository function sets it via setdefault)
bind_workspace_to_scenario's replay_metadata DOES pass scenario_id (from saved_record.scenario_id)
scenario_summary_cards include 10 specific fields (scenario_id, scenario_name, project_code, updated_at, copied_from_scenario_id, project_irr, equity_irr, avg_dscr, export_count, governance_state)
scenario_summary_cards.export_count is computed by counting entries in export_lineage per scenario_name
Response is a full workspace render (NOT an HTMX partial); no HX-Trigger / no HX-Redirect / no template
Route does NOT call _validate_form (accepts any form input as a snapshot; same as /scenarios/state/draft and /discard)
Route does NOT wrap its body in a broad except Exception (errors propagate to FastAPI default 500 handler)
behavior_quirks: Quirk 1: scenario_name is built as f'{project_name} {snapshot.get(scenario, Base)} {dt.now().strftime(%Y-%m-%d %H:%M)}' (timestamp is the name suffix, no separate field)
Quirk 2: Blocked message replaces underscores with spaces: project_origin.replace('_', ' ')
Quirk 3: Blocked message includes the suggestion: 'Use Save As to create a user project.'
Quirk 4: last_run_summary is preserved if and only if existing_workspace_state exists AND its last_runtime_snapshot equals the current snapshot. Otherwise reset to {}.
Quirk 5: Blocked branch is a soft-fail (200 + render with error message), NOT a hard 4xx error. save_scenario and bind_workspace_to_scenario are NEVER called in the blocked branch.
Quirk 6: No HX-Trigger header (unlike /save-run which sets HX-Trigger: refreshHistory). Success response is a full workspace render, not an HTMX partial.
Quirk 7: scenario_summary_cards include an 'export_count' field, computed by counting entries in export_lineage per scenario_name

Quirk 8: scenario_summary_cards include specific fields: scenario_id, scenario_name, project_code, updated_at, copied_from_scenario_id, project_irr, equity_irr, avg_dscr, export_count, governance_state
Quirk 9: Two distinct export_type values: save_scenario uses 'saved_scenario_snapshot'; bind_workspace_to_scenario uses 'workspace_saved_boundary' (non-ASCII char may be escaped)
Quirk 10: Route does NOT call _validate_form. Accepts any form input as a snapshot. (Same as /scenarios/state/draft and /scenarios/state/discard.)

extraction_recommendation_for_51J_2.rationale: Matches the canonical Phase 51B-51H-2 pattern (one service per route family). Keeps scenario_state_service.py data-layer only. /scenarios/save has different concerns from /scenarios/state/* (creates a ScenarioRecord + binds workspace, not just workspace mutations) so it should NOT extend scenario_state_route_service.py either.
extraction_recommendation_for_51J_2.option_a_considered: Extend app/services/scenario_state_service.py with route orchestration. Rejected because scenario_state_service.py is data-layer only (no Request, no form, no auth) and adding route orchestration would mix concerns.
extraction_recommendation_for_51J_2.option_b_considered_extend_scenario_stat: Extend app/services/scenario_state_route_service.py with /scenarios/save. Rejected because that service handles workspace mutations WITHOUT scenario row creation, while /scenarios/save creates a new ScenarioRecord. Different concerns.
candidate_api_for_51J_2: ScenarioSaveRouteOutcome (dataclass: payload, status_code, headers, is_redirect, redirect_url, render_context: dict)
ScenarioSaveRouteDeps (dataclass: ~13-15 callables; no constants since the route does not validate the form)
execute_scenarios_save_route(*, request, form, user, deps) -> ScenarioSaveRouteOutcome (single entry point that handles both the block check and the success path)
candidate_deps_bundle_callables: (potentially) dt_provider (a callable returning datetime, to allow test injection; alternatively just use dt.now directly)
(potentially) is_blocked_project_origin (a callable that returns True for factory_template / saved_baseline; alternatively just check inline)
behavior_preservation_required: All intended side effects (save_scenario × 1, bind_workspace_to_scenario × 1, read queries × 1 each)
Soft-block behavior (200 + render with error message) preserved
302 redirect to /login (NOT 401 JSON; this is HTMX-redirect auth pattern)

remaining_risks: soft-block vs hard-error semantics (Quirk 5) must be preserved in 51J-2. The block check should stay in the service, not the route.
last_run_summary conditional (Quirk 4) is subtle. 51J-2 must preserve it exactly.
scenario_name timestamp format '%Y-%m-%d %H:%M' is fixed. 51J-2 must preserve it exactly.
scenario_summary_cards shape (10 fields including export_count) is pinned. 51J-2 must preserve the card dict shape exactly.
Two distinct export_type values (saved_scenario_snapshot, workspace_saved_boundary) must be preserved.
302 redirect to /login (NOT 401 JSON) is the auth pattern for this route. 51J-2 must keep auth in the route (route-owned) and the service does not produce redirects itself.
The bind_workspace_to_scenario always called after save_scenario ordering is critical. 51J-2 must preserve it. If save_scenario raises, bind_workspace is not called.
